title: Cross-check a payout in Chrome and Numbers
task: Compare a payout total in a web dashboard with the finance sheet in a native app, flag any mismatch, and stop before editing.
summary: Browser read the payout total from a finance dashboard. The native runtime looked at the Numbers sheet, then dry-ran the comparison step. The run found a $40 mismatch and made no edits.

verdict.label: Mismatch found
verdict.detail: $12,480.00 in the dashboard vs $12,520.00 in the sheet — a $40.00 difference. Nothing was edited.
